kjv: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

lines.say: Wind down with this one tonight.
lines.big: Wind down with this one tonight

lines.say: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation. Psalm sixty two, verse one.
lines.big: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

lines.say: Waiting isn't wasted time. It's where he does his work.
lines.big: Waiting isn't wasted time. It's where he does his work.

lines.say: Lord, my soul waits on you tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
